scientific_integrity.proof_scope: Analytical vertex-reduction and endpoint-classification proof for every integer n at least three.
scientific_integrity.provenance_note: All quoted prior literature is acknowledged; the earlier complete polar-vertex description and second-moment inradius are not presented as new.
scientific_integrity.verification_scope: Exact-rational finite computations reproduce examples and identities; they are not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Finite unit-edge crown graphs with n at least three, real edge-one-Lipschitz functions and uniform normalized vertex measure only.
The theorem evaluates the fourth centered moment, not every even or real moment exponent.
Independent assessment of proof and priority has not been performed; equivalent unindexed work may exist.
title: The sharp fourth centered Lipschitz moment of crown graphs and its twelve-pair transition
